question: What is the name of the 87th element on the periodic table that has no known biological role because it has a half-life of only 22 minutes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Francium.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• **Francium is a highly radioactive metal.**
 
• **It is the second rarest element in the Earth's crust.**
 
• It was discovered in 1939 by Marguerite Perey.
 
• It is named af
